candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, causing gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502; the gateway's own readiness is healthy and failures are fast, pointing to an error in the order service rather than gateway latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/traces and dependency metrics are absent, so the specific 500 trigger (db pool, redis, payment) is not established.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show gateway /v1/checkout returning 502 immediately after order /v1/orders returns 500, with healthy /readyz and fast durations. Root cause is bounded to order-service 500s; the specific downstream mechanism requires order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders 500 responses
Order dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to distinguish db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or downstream-latency
